title: Simple Machines for Kids! Wheels, Levers and Ramps
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Gizmo the robot, and welcome to Gizmo Explains!
I love asking, how does that work? Today we're going to find out how simple machines help us.
We'll explore five cool things. Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
When my antenna lights up, it means I have an idea!

lines: Here's a clue: it's round, and it goes round and round! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Dragging a heavy box is hard, because it rubs on the ground.
Wheels roll instead of rubbing, so wagons, cars, and bikes move along easily!
Can you roll your arms round and round like a wheel?
They roll, so things are easier to move!
One more time, nice and loud: WHEEL!
Wheels are on wagons, strollers, trains, and even shopping carts.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: a seesaw is one, up and down! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
A lever is a long bar that rests on a point, called a fulcrum.
Push down on one end, and the other end goes up! It helps you lift heavy things.
Can you be a seesaw? One arm up, one arm down!
What happens when you push down on a lever?
One more time, nice and loud: LEVER!
A seesaw at the playground is a lever you can ride on!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's a slope that goes up, like a little hill! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Lifting a heavy box straight up is really hard.
A ramp is a longer path, but each push is smaller. So moving things up gets easier!
Can you walk your fingers up a pretend ramp, step, step, step?
Ramps make it easier to move things up high!
One more time, nice and loud: RAMP!
Ramps help wheelchairs, strollers, and delivery carts go up and down.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's a wheel with a rope that helps lift things! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
A pulley is a wheel with a rope going over the top.
When you pull the rope down, the thing on the other end goes up! Pulling down is easier than lifting up.
Can you pull a pretend rope, hand over hand?
Which way do you pull to lift with a pulley?
Down! And the bucket goes up.
One more time, nice and loud: PULLEY!
Flagpoles use a pulley to raise the flag to the very top.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it twists, and it has a spiral around it! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
A screw is like a tiny ramp, wrapped around and around a pole.
When you twist it, the spiral pulls the screw in, and it holds things together tight!
Can you twist your body around and around, like a screw?
It twists in and holds things together!
One more time, nice and loud: SCREW!
Jar lids twist on the same way. That's a screw too!
Now we know how it works. Great job!

recap: Wow, we learned so much! Let's remember.
Pulleys lift when you pull down.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Keep asking, how does that work?
Bye, friends! See you next time on Gizmo Explains!
